root_cause.text: ext4’s `parse_apply_sb_mount_options()` copied the on-disk `s_mount_opts` field into an oversized 65-byte local buffer using `strscpy_pad()`, which is unsafe for a possibly non-NUL-terminated source and triggered an out-of-bounds read/FORTIFY warning when the source lacked a terminator.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `char s_mount_opts[65];` to `char s_mount_opts[64];` and adds `if (strscpy_pad(s_mount_opts, sbi->s_es->s_mount_opts) < 0) return -E2BIG;`, while the CVE description explicitly says `strscpy_pad()` “can't be used to copy a non-NUL-term string into a NUL-term string of possibly bigger size” and reports a `strnlen: detected buffer overflow: 65 byte read of buffer size 64` in `parse_apply_sb_mount_options()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Adjust the temporary mount-options buffer size in `parse_apply_sb_mount_options()` from 65 to 64 bytes.
intent_record.what: The local stack buffer declaration in `parse_apply_sb_mount_options()` was changed from `char s_mount_opts[65];` to `char s_mount_opts[64];`.
intent_record.how: This reduces the size of the temporary mount-options buffer by one byte, which changes the amount of stack space reserved for parsing the superblock mount option string.

intent_record.intent_summary: Reject oversized stored mount options by propagating `-E2BIG` when the copy into the mount-options buffer fails.
intent_record.what: The code now checks the return value of `strscpy_pad(s_mount_opts, sbi->s_es->s_mount_opts)` and returns `-E2BIG` if the copy fails, instead of ignoring the result.
intent_record.how: At runtime, overly long mount option strings can no longer be silently truncated or misprocessed; the function now aborts with an error when the source string does not fit in the destination buffer.

The oversized temporary buffer is part of the vulnerable pattern: the pre-fix 65-byte destination combined with copying from an untrusted on-disk field contributed to the unsafe handling of mount options.

This oversized temporary buffer is part of the vulnerable pre-fix handling in parse_apply_sb_mount_options(); it enabled the unsafe copy path that processed the on-disk mount-options field before the fix.
